description_en: Force deletes an Express Connect Router (ECR) and detaches its associated virtual private clouds (VPCs), Transit Routers (TRs), and virtual border routers (VBRs)
description_zh: 删除专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router），并解绑相关联的专有网络（VPC），转发路由器（TR）和边界路由器（VBR）
name: ForceDeleteExpressConnectRouter

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run to check the request. No resources are modified.

false (default): Sends a standard request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECR instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure that the request is idempotent.

Generate a unique parameter value from your client. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. Each API request has a unique RequestId
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful. For more information about other response codes, see Error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为 200 表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the value of the ErrMessage parameter.

If the value of ErrMessage is The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and the value of DynamicMessage is DtsJobId, it indicates that the specified DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

True: The request was successful.

False: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败
